method: ast.parse plus source reading only; the original R15 module was never imported or executed in this pass. Byte/value semantics below are read from the wrapper body and from the retained replay receipt, not re-measured

additional_original_entrypoint.name: ingest_minute_staging
additional_original_entrypoint.note: not in the three named targets but present and called; recorded so the minute path is not mistaken for something this wrapper re-implements

staging_selectors.manifest_written_by_wrapper: <root>/08_DAILY_SOURCE_HANDOFF/STAGING_MANIFEST.json, built by build_staging() from the two RETAINED names
staging_selectors.hard_block: HARD_BLOCK if a retained batch is missing at the source path

source_to_clean_rel_mapping.rule: clean_rel = f"price/stock_ohlcv_daily/{name}" where name is the retained parquet basename
source_to_clean_rel_mapping.shape: flat 1:1 per staged file; not a date- or code-partitioned mapping in this body

byte_placement.mechanism: carry-forward of the sealed parent standard tree: a junction is recreated as a junction to the same target (zero copy), a real directory is created and recursed, a real file is hard-linked
byte_placement.why_not_the_original_hardlink_tree: rglob follows reparse points; production standard has ~32-release junction chains plus a real junction cycle, so the original never terminates (observed: 25 min CPU spin, 0 bytes produced)
byte_placement.fail_closed: if the materialised source/destination file sets differ the wrapper writes MATERIALIZE_INCOMPLETE.json and raises SystemExit; a partial materialisation was observed to drop 12 r2_repair files and collapse 2026-07-03..07-10 to 19 codes

value_transform.mechanism: the ORIGINAL R15 function bodies perform the value transform; the wrapper only injects paths and orders the calls
value_transform.bounded_proof: the retained replay receipt records replayed_bytes_match_retained = True for the two retained units; that is bounded evidence, not proof of every transformation

exclusions.not_materialised: the minute products (~1e5 files); the remaining top-level children stay as junctions to the same targets
exclusions.hard_link_safety_precheck: refuses to start if any target clean_rel already exists in the production parent standard root, unless carry-forward is explicitly disabled

in_this_wrapper.finance_asof / daily_asof: set equal to asof in the candidate pointer

align_pit_handling.in_the_original_bodies: date alignment and look-ahead gating live inside the R15 ingest/seal and antileak bodies, which this pass did not re-implement and did not step through

potentially_writable_destinations_visibl.note: a copy of production SSOT; amend_ssot is redirected to this copy

potentially_writable_destinations_visibl.destination: production standard inodes reached through hard links
potentially_writable_destinations_visibl.why: carry-forward hard-links real files, so a candidate path shares an inode with production. The only operation that could reach a shared inode is place_file, which does unlink then link and never an in-place write. The wrapper makes this provable rather than assumed with the pre-check plus before/after production sampling

potentially_writable_destinations_visibl.destination: production SSOT (HAND full data update scope R1)

not_claimed_by_that_receipt: production CURRENT not switched (switch_current not called)
production HAND not patched (patch_hand not called)
the replay proves the R15 functions run on the retained batches, not that the original vendor download returned them
antileak/SSOT here validate the candidate tree only

not_established: the internal value transforms of the original ingest/seal/antileak bodies were not stepped through in this pass
no byte-range or row-level transform certificate was produced because the collector did not run
which code an earlier process executed remains UNKNOWN; current source hashes are not an execution certificate
